chunks: And by this chain: He said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Allah, Mighty and Majestic, did not create any creature except that He appointed another over it to overcome it. And that is because when Allah, Blessed and High, created the lower seas, they prided themselves and surged, and said, 'Which thing can overcome me?' So He created the earth, and it surfaced upon its back, and it became submissive.

Then he said: Indeed, the earth prided itself and said, 'Which thing can overcome me?' So He created the mountains and established them upon its back as pegs so that it would not sway due to what is upon it. So the earth became submissive and settled. Then indeed the mountains prided themselves over the earth, so they rose high and elongated, and said, 'Which thing can overcome me?' So He created the iron, which cut them, so the mountains calmed down and became submissive.
Then indeed the iron prided itself over the mountains and said, 'Which thing can overcome me?' So He created the Fire, which melted the iron, so the iron became submissive.
Then indeed the Fire exhaled and gasped and prided itself and said, 'Which thing can overcome me?' So He created the water, which extinguished it, so it became submissive.

Then indeed the water prided itself and surged and said, 'Which thing can overcome me?' So He created the wind, which moved its waves and raised what was in its bottom, and restrained it from its currents, so the water became submissive.

Then indeed the wind prided itself, raged, and loosened its tails, and said, 'Which thing can overcome me?' So He created the human being, who built and devised, and took what he could hide from the wind and other things, so the wind became humble.
Then indeed the human being rebelled and said, 'Who is stronger than me in power?' So Allah created Death for him, which subdued him, so the human being became submissive.

Then indeed Death prided itself in its own self, so Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: 'Do not be proud, for I will slaughter you between the two groups - the people of Paradise and the people of the Fire. Then I will not revive you ever, so you are hoped for or feared.'

And he also said: 'Forbearance overcomes anger, and mercy overcomes harshness, and charity overcomes sin.' Then Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: 'This is similar to that which may overcome something else.'
ai.seo_question: What is the hierarchy of creation and how do virtues overcome negative traits according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This cosmological narrative from *Al-Kafi* illustrates the concept of *al-ghalabah* (dominance) within creation, where each entity's pride is met with a divinely appointed counter-force, culminating in human dominion over nature and death's subjugation by the Hereafter. Scholarly tradition interprets this hierarchy as a metaphor for spiritual ethics, where intellectual virtues like forbearance (*hilm*) and mercy ultimately conquer base impulses, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the refinement of character as a means of aligning with divine order.

en.hubeali: H 14577 – And by this chain: Heasws said: ‘The Prophetsaww said: ‘Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic did not Create a creature except that Heazwj Commanded another one to overcome it, and that Allahazwj Blessed and High, when Heazwj Created the deeper ocean, it prided itself and moved its waves and said, ‘Which thing can overcome me?’ So Heazwj Created the earth, so it (ocean) surfaced upon its back, and so it became submissive.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> said; ‘The earth prided itself and said, ‘Which thing can overcome me?’ So He<sup>azwj</sup> Created the mountains and Established them as pegs upon its back, so stop it from swaying due to what is upon her.

So the earth became submissive and stabilised. Then the mountain prided itself over the earth, so it became bigger and taller, and said, ‘Which thing can overcome me?’ So He<sup>azwj</sup> Created the iron which cut it, and so the mountain calmed down and became submissive. Then the iron prided itself over the mountain and said, ‘Which thing can overcome me?’ So He<sup>azwj</sup> Created the Fire which melted it, and so the iron became submissive.

Then the fire exhaled and gasped (blazed), and prided itself and said, ‘Which thing can overcome me?’ So He<sup>azwj</sup> Created the water which extinguished it, and so it became submissive. Then the water prided itself and overflowed and said, ‘Which thing can overcome me?’
So He<sup>azwj</sup> Created the wind which moved its waves and raised what was in its bottom, and restrained it from its direction, and so the water became submissive.

Then the wind prided itself, raged and loosened its tails and said, ‘Which thing can overcome me?’ So He<sup>azwj</sup> Created the human being who built shelters and tricked the wind by veiling himself from it and other, so the wind became humble.
Then the human being rebelled and said, ‘Who is stronger than me?’ So He<sup>azwj</sup> Created the death for him, which defeated him, and so he became submissive.

Then the death prided itself so Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Said: “Do not be proud, for I<sup>azwj</sup> will Slaughter you in between the two sects – the people of the Paradise and the people of the Fire, then I<sup>azwj</sup> will not Revive you ever, whether you return (repent) or you fear”.

And he<sup>asws</sup> also said: ‘And the forbearance overcomes the anger, and the mercy overcomes the harshness, and the charity overcomes the sins’. Then Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is more like this where one thing overcomes the other’.
